baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'make between you and between those you opposed affection.'
baseline_models.mechanism: State-transformation, the doubled relational interval, and affection combine into a model in which a connective relation is produced in the shared space between two parties. The verse need not mean only that matching private feelings arise inside separate people.

activation_trace.role: The image of putting something into a new state supplies active relational transformation rather than passive discovery.
The interval or middle between two sides gives the transformation a shared spatial and social site.
The branch of an existing connection between parties turns the interval into a possible bond rather than an empty gap.
Affection supplies the positive connective content that is made to occupy the shared relation.

changed_reading.before: Perhaps God will cause former enemies to feel friendly toward one another.
changed_reading.after: Perhaps God will construct affection as a shared relation in the very interval that currently separates the two sides.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The promise of making affection is immediately followed by powerful, forgiving, and merciful.
baseline_models.mechanism: Power is activated as effective, measured governance; forgiveness protects a wrongdoer from the continuing effect of a wrong; mercy adds tenderness. The closing predicates can therefore name a repair mechanism: past injury is neither denied nor allowed to dictate the permanent relational state.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity supplies the ability to bring the proposed relational change into action.
Measured governance supplies calibration, making reconciliation an ordered repair rather than an arbitrary emotional flip.
Covering a wrong while protecting its bearer from its effect supplies a way past the residue of hostility.
Tenderness and beneficence supply the positive treatment that can follow protective forgiveness.
Affection is the repaired relation produced when injury no longer monopolizes the future.

changed_reading.before: Power, forgiveness, and mercy are reassuring divine attributes appended to the prediction.
changed_reading.after: The attributes describe how the prediction can become real: calibrated power changes the relation, forgiveness contains past harm, and mercy supplies a new mode of treatment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled 'between' retains two grammatical sides even while affection is placed across them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The middle-state branch of between and the form-distant side or bank branch carried by the enemy root generate a boundary-preserving model. Affection can become a third relational condition spanning opposed sides without requiring identity merger, indiscriminate alliance, or the denial that opposition occurred.

activation_trace.role: A middle condition between two poles supplies affection as a third state rather than a binary enemy-to-identical switch.
The form-distant image of a side or bank preserves opposed locations across which the new relation can run.
Actual enmity keeps the spatial model anchored in the verse's explicit prior relation.
Affection supplies a bridge-like relation while leaving the parties grammatically distinct.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation means that the enemy category simply flips into friendship.
changed_reading.after: Affection may become a stable middle relation across a maintained boundary, so changed treatment need not erase every distinction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier affection is cast toward the other side under concealment, while the same desire root also names the adversaries' wish for the believers' disbelief. In 60:7 affection is no longer a one-way covert transmission or morally unqualified wish; it is made between both parties as a reciprocal relational field.

activation_trace.role: Casting something outward supplies the earlier one-directional delivery of affection toward the adversary.
Affection is the repeated object being directed toward the other side before it becomes a shared relation.
Concealment locates the earlier affectionate act in a hidden channel and sharpens its contrast with a relation openly made between parties.
Wishing for an outcome shows that desire itself is directional and can carry a hostile object, so affection cannot be reduced to mere wishing.
Transformation replaces covert projection with a newly constituted relation.
The connective relation between parties supplies reciprocity and shared location.
Affection is retained but its direction and social form are changed.

structural_cues: 60:1 twice directs affection 'to them,' whereas 60:7 locates affection in the doubled 'between you and between them.'
60:2 uses the same desire root for the adversaries' wish that the believers disbelieve, separating desire's force from its ethical object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casting, concealed affection, hostile wishing, and affection made between; I infer a movement from unilateral secret projection to a reciprocal relation. A live alternative is that the passages only contrast prohibited and permitted objects without describing a developmental transformation.

changed_reading.before: 60:7 merely permits the affection that 60:1 had prohibited.
changed_reading.after: 60:7 changes affection's structure: a hidden one-way offer and a hostile counter-wish can be replaced by a relation genuinely made between both sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first marks a separating boundary, then makes hostility and aversion appear in the doubled space between the parties with a claim of duration. The focus reuses that spatial frame but gives it affection as new content. The change is not vague softening; it is an inversion of what occupies the shared interval.

activation_trace.role: Making a boundary visible supplies the prior separated geometry of the two groups.
Openly manifesting enmity turns hostility into visible content placed in the intergroup space.
The relation between parties is already an occupied connective field, here carrying hostility rather than affection.
Explicit enmity supplies one pole of the affective content that 60:7 reverses.
Aversive feeling opposite love supplies the direct affective contrary of the focus's affection.
Long duration supplies the apparent permanence that the focus's open possibility interrupts.
Changing a thing's state supplies the reversal of the interval's affective content.
The same connective field now carries a possible bond.
Affection supplies the replacement content for visible hostility and aversion.

structural_cues: 60:4 and 60:7 both repeat 'between us/you and between you/them' and place an affective noun in that frame.
The duration term in 60:4 is followed by an 'until' boundary, so its permanence claim is grammatically held inside a condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visibly occupied interval, hostility, aversion, duration, and then affection in the same frame; I infer replacement of the interval's governing affect. A live alternative is coexistence or a later exception affecting only some members rather than transformation of the relation itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers a hopeful exception after an emphatic declaration of hostility.
changed_reading.after: The focus re-enters the exact relational space where hostility had appeared and proposes that its durable-seeming content can be remade as affection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer asks not to be made into an ordeal for the rejecting group and immediately asks forgiveness; the next ayah locates hope in God. The focus then repeats making, forgiveness, and hope-like possibility but supplies affection as the made result. This supports an abductive answer-pattern: an inflammatory or testing intergroup configuration can be converted into a reparative one.

activation_trace.role: Being put into the state of an ordeal supplies the negative alternative to being put into a relation of affection.
Testing a person as metal is tested supplies the pressured communal state from which a different outcome is requested.
Protective forgiveness joins the negative prayer to the focus's later repair mechanism.
The heart's orientation toward a hoped-for good supplies the immediate posture from which the focus's possibility is heard.
Hope for nourishment to return after cessation gives the possibility a restorative rather than merely uncertain force.
State-transformation supplies affection as the alternative made condition.
Affection names the positive communal result that displaces the ordeal configuration.
Repeated protective forgiveness makes the proposed answer-pattern internally coherent.

structural_cues: 60:5 and 60:7 repeat the verb of making and the forgiveness root but give the made relation opposite valences.
60:6's explicit hope immediately precedes the focus's opening possibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prayer against being made an ordeal, a forgiveness request, explicit hope, and then affection made with forgiveness; I infer that 60:7 can function as an answer-shaped reversal. A live alternative is lexical echo without any prayer-and-answer direction.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated forecast that hostility may someday soften.
changed_reading.after: The focus may answer the prior prayer by converting a community's role from intergroup ordeal into a field of affection, with forgiveness carried across the conversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Benevolent connection and equitable dealing provide observable practices after the focus, while the love root also carries a seed that grows. The following restriction on protective alliance with active aggressors preserves a boundary. Affection can therefore be cultivated through just conduct toward eligible others without becoming indiscriminate allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Connection and beneficence supply a concrete practice through which a repaired relation can be enacted.
Justice and fair dealing supply the balancing discipline that keeps affection from becoming partiality.
The grain that sprouts licenses a contained cultivation image for affection emerging from repeated just acts.
Love abiding in the heart links the cultivation image back to the focus's affective result.
Alliance combining love and support supplies the stronger relation that the next ayah restricts under active aggression.
Producing something supplies the emergence of a relation through practices rather than spontaneous sentiment alone.
The interparty connection is the social site in which benevolence and equity can accumulate.
Affection is the possible fruit of the ethically bounded process.

structural_cues: 60:8 and 60:9 distinguish groups by fighting and expulsion rather than treating every outsider as one fixed enemy class.
The command to act benevolently and equitably follows the focus immediately, while alliance with active aggressors remains prohibited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies benevolence, equity, divine love, seed imagery, and a boundary around alliance; I infer that repeated just contact can cultivate the affection of 60:7. A live alternative is that the legal distinction only regulates conduct and does not describe affection's causal growth.

changed_reading.before: Affection arrives as a miraculous private feeling and therefore risks erasing political or legal distinctions.
changed_reading.after: Affection can grow from benevolent and equitable conduct inside an aggression-sensitive boundary, changing relation without suspending judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later legal sequence prohibits returning migrant women, loosens former marital eligibility, forbids holding protective bonds with rejecters, and adjudicates between the communities. This constrains the focus's return imagery: communal affection need not restore every prior bond. A relation between groups can be remade precisely while coercive or invalid intimate ties remain released.

activation_trace.role: Return to the former state is explicitly blocked, supplying a limit on restoration as the meaning of reconciliation.
Loosening a knot supplies dissolution of a prior bond rather than its sentimental reinstatement.
Holding and confining supplies the attachment that the legal instruction refuses to preserve.
A protective restraining bond supplies the specific tie whose release can coexist with broader intergroup repair.
Judgment between people supplies an institutional process for managing the separated relations.
The connection between parties is governed even while particular bonds are dissolved.
The packet's non-dominant return image activates restoration but is revised by the later prohibition of literal return.
Transformation permits a new relational state instead of simple reinstatement of the old one.
The broader intergroup connection remains the scale at which affection can be made.

structural_cues: 60:10 repeatedly negates return, mutual marital eligibility, and retention of the former bond before commanding judgment between the parties.
The focus concerns affection between communities, while 60:10 distinguishes that scale from specific marital ties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked return, loosened and unheld bonds, and judgment between groups; I infer a scale distinction in which communal reconciliation can coexist with irreversible personal separation. A live alternative is that the marriage law has no constraining force on the focus's reconciliation model.

changed_reading.before: Making affection means restoring people and relationships to their earlier configuration.
changed_reading.after: Making affection can create a new communal relation without returning vulnerable people or reviving every dissolved bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: A lost spouse creates a relational and material gap; substitute liability and equivalent expenditure repair the asymmetry. Read back into 60:7, measured power and affection between parties can include restitution. Reconciliation is not amnesia about loss but a settlement that removes one engine of renewed resentment.

activation_trace.role: A gap between two things supplies the relational and material deficit left by loss.
The marital pair identifies the concrete bond whose loss generates the deficit.
A substitute or guarantee supplies the compensatory transfer that follows the loss.
Equivalence supplies the proportional rule governing repair.
Money that has gone out supplies the measurable loss to be restored.
A determinate amount supplies the measured dimension of relational repair.
Fitting a thing to its proper measure supplies proportionality between loss and restitution.
The widened gap between parties is the social space that measured restitution can narrow.
Affection becomes the possible relational consequence of repaired asymmetry.

structural_cues: 60:10-11 repeat reciprocal expenditure claims and require equivalent compensation across the group boundary.
The compensation does not undo departure; it repairs what can be measured after departure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss, a gap, substitution, equivalence, and expenditure; I infer that restitution can remove a cause of resentment and help affection become durable. A live alternative is that compensation only prevents injustice and has no affective consequence.

changed_reading.before: Affection bypasses prior losses through a direct change of heart.
changed_reading.after: Affection may become possible through measured repair of losses, so the shared relation changes without pretending that nothing was taken or spent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge establishes an explicit relation of committed conduct, recognized good names its governing norm, and the focus's exact forgiveness-mercy pair returns at the close. This strengthens the repair model: mercy does not merely overlook history but receives people through accountable covenant and then protects their possibility of belonging.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience supplies an explicit social bond and accountable entry into the community.
Recognized good supplies the intelligible ethical norm shaping the pledged relation.
Protective forgiveness supplies reintegration after the pledge rather than exclusion by prior wrong alone.
Tender mercy supplies beneficent treatment within the newly covenanted relation.
The same protective forgiveness links the focus's affection to later accountable reintegration.
The repeated mercy branch makes tenderness part of the social mechanism rather than an isolated closing formula.
Affection names the positive relation that accountable forgiveness can sustain.

structural_cues: 60:12 places a detailed pledge before the command to seek forgiveness and then repeats the focus's exact forgiving-merciful close.
The pledge regulates specific harms while still ending in mercy, holding accountability and reception together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant, recognized good, forgiveness, mercy, and the repeated close; I infer that accountable reintegration is one durable form of the affection anticipated in 60:7. A live alternative is that the repetition only reassures the new believers and does not explain the earlier affection.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and mercy simply soften the emotional tone of the focus.
changed_reading.after: The later pledge shows forgiveness and mercy operating as accountable reception, allowing affection to become a durable social bond rather than unstructured leniency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Explicit hope before the focus and doubled severance of hope near the close form an affective polarity. The grave image intensifies terminal closure. Between them, the focus's hope for nourishment to return and affection to be made prevents present hostility from being treated as a dead, buried, irreversible ontology.

activation_trace.role: The heart reaching toward a hoped-for good supplies the positive orientation immediately before the focus.
The cutting off of hope, repeated twice, supplies the terminal affect against which the focus remains open.
Burial supplies the concrete terminal image that makes closed hope feel relationally final.
Hope for milk to return after cessation supplies a material counterimage to severed expectation.
The non-dominant image of return after departure keeps reversal live inside the word for those previously opposed.
Affection is the hoped-for relation that refuses terminal closure.

structural_cues: 60:6 places explicit hope immediately before 60:7, while 60:13 repeats despair twice at the pericope's close.
The focus uses possibility rather than certainty, keeping change live without claiming it for every adversary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hope, possibility, doubled despair, and burial; I infer that 60:7 interrupts a terminal reading of enmity. A live alternative is that 60:13's despair concerns only its immediate group and creates no deliberate polarity with the focus.

changed_reading.before: The focus voices a cautious hope that may or may not be realized.
changed_reading.after: The focus performs anti-terminal work: it keeps adversarial relation open to return and affection without universalizing or guaranteeing the outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the form-distant milk-return branch of the opening possibility with the non-dominant return mapping carried under the enemy root. It remains anchored in the focus's opening, the named former adversaries, and affection as the result. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for restored relational nourishment, never as a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse opens with a branch image of hoped-for milk after cessation and names former adversaries through a root inventory that also exposes return and returning benefit.

activation_trace.role: Hope that milk will resume after drying supplies the material model of a relationship becoming nourishing again.
Return after departure supplies reversal within the packet's non-dominant mapping of the former-enemy expression.
A benefit that comes back supplies the relational yield of the return rather than return as mere repetition.
Affection anchors the returning nourishment image in the explicit changed relation.

changed_reading.before: A dead relationship may be replaced by an unrelated new feeling.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a relation that had gone dry may resume giving benefit, with affection figured as nourishment returning after cessation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the concrete covering and womb branches beneath divine forgiveness and mercy, then treats them as one material mechanism. It remains anchored in the focus's act of creating affection and its immediate forgiving-merciful close. Downstream prose should qualify it as a protected-growth analogy, not imply that the concrete branches are the direct denotation of the divine names.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Affection is made and immediately enclosed by the paired roots of protective covering and womb-linked mercy.

activation_trace.role: Creating something supplies the emergence of a new and initially vulnerable relational life.
Affection is the explicit relational life whose protected growth the analogy models.
A covering that preserves what it encloses supplies protection from exposure to renewed injury.
The womb as a container for emerging life supplies a gestational image for affection before it becomes socially durable.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and mercy follow after affection has already been made.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, forgiveness and mercy form the protective enclosure in which newly made affection can survive long enough to mature.

strongest_changes: Affection changes from a hidden one-way casting toward enemies into a relation made reciprocally between the parties.
The doubled 'between' turns 60:7 into a direct reversal of the visible hostility and aversion that previously occupied the same relational interval.

Benevolence, equity, release of invalid bonds, measured restitution, covenant, forgiveness, and mercy supply possible practices and institutions through which the changed relation can endure without indiscriminate alliance.
The focus's possibility keeps enmity nonterminal between explicit hope and the pericope's later doubled despair.
summary.what_was_special: The split inventory under the enemy root kept return and returning benefit live beside actual hostility, while milk-return, seed, covering, and womb branches yielded material models of relational restoration. These activations changed the reading without being promoted into direct translations.
remaining_uncertainties: The sequence strongly supports contrast and echo, but the causal arrows from justice, restitution, or covenant to affection remain reader-supplied abductions.
The scale of the promised affection may range from particular former adversaries or kin to a broader communal relation.
The form-distant return, side, milk, seed, cover, and womb images are productive but should remain explicitly exploratory.
The later legal material may constrain the meaning of reconciliation more securely than it explains how affection is generated.
